proc=subprocess.Popen(['uv', 'run', '--with', 'numpy', '--with', 'scipy', 'python', '-B', 'tests/run.py'], cwd='/Users/bugsincode/.t3/worktrees/unbug-bench/t3-4ac6b632', start_new_session=True)
